Consensus values are Mako-curated and arrive with provenance (source, source_url, published_at, age_days). An event with no curated consensus carries consensus: null, which means the value is not published rather than zero.

tools.name: list_loops
tools.description: List all available Jawz loops. Returns loop metadata, access status, and which loop is currently active for this user. Every published loop is free and open. Deprecated loops you are entitled to are included with deprecated: true.

tools.name: get_loop
tools.description: Get metadata and chapter manifest for a loop by slug. Returns loop info and the list of chapter nodes with titles — no chapter content. All active loops are navigable by anyone.

tools.name: get_chapter
tools.description: Fetch the full content of a chapter by loop slug and node. Loops not marked open require entitlement; every published loop is currently open and free. Does not log an invocation; run_chapter is the variant that runs the framework and logs.

tools.name: run_chapter
tools.description: Returns a chapter's published framework text: its modes, the questions each asks, and the output format it describes. tools.name: run_mode
tools.description: Returns the published framework text for one named mode within a chapter, rather than the full chapter. Repeat calls return the same mode content — the text is not regenerated per call. Each call appends one usage-counter row and returns a new invocation_id used for feedback.

tools.name: get_china_liquidity
tools.description: Read the latest Mako-curated PBoC balance-sheet publication (CNY trillions + source URL + as_of_month + note).
